voice.summary: Longhand writes like a manifesto pinned to a workshop wall: short, certain and humble. It prefers verbs to values and ends on a single plain instruction.
dos: Make each line a belief that can be acted on
End on a single clear imperative
donts: Do not cite founders or awards
Do not bury the statement in qualifiers

taglines: Write it down, then do it
What we believe, in plain words
boilerplate: Longhand is a small studio that makes things built to last, and publishes its beliefs as a short manifesto anyone can read in a minute.
